components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in an operational context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: 650 13px/1.2 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral supporting action that stays subordinate to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 650 13px/1.2 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); border-color: var(--text-subtle); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-selected); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A persistent-label field for trusted operational input.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-provider">Provider name<input class="ds-field" id="ds-provider" placeholder="University or programme"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 600 13px/1.2 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 15px/1.5 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--brand-gold-dark); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--text-subtle); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #777067; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The quiet cream route marker used in desktop and mobile navigation.
components.html: OverviewScholarships
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 216px; display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 12px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.2 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--surface-selected); color: var(--text); font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Success Status Badge
components.description: A compact text-first marker for healthy or completed workflow state.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid #b9d9cb; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); font: 700 11px/1.2 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-badge-success:hover { border-color: var(--success); } .ds-badge-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Panel
components.description: A flat bordered container for related records, forms, or status details.
components.html:
Recent crawl activity

Live records remain visually stronger than the container.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 15px/1.5 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 650; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px; color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: A single segmented surface for compact live operational totals.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface); font-family: Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric { min-width: 0; padding: 16px 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-metric:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-metric span { display: block; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; } .ds-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text); font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric small { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; } .ds-metric:hover { background: #fbfaf7; } .ds-metric:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The core dense-record pattern with sticky muted headers and restrained row feedback.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface); } .ds-table { width: 100%; min-width: 480px; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 14px/1.5 Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table th { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface-muted); text-align: left; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.015em; } .ds-table td { min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-table td:first-child { color: var(--text); font-weight: 540; } .ds-table td:last-child { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #fbfaf7; } .ds-table tbody tr:focus-within td { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-table-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid #b9d9cb; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
Study Worldwide treats scholarship evidence as the primary material. Warm paper, white working surfaces, near-black ink, and small antique-brass details give the workspace the authority of an established international academic organization without compromising the speed or density of professional operations software.

The interface is editorial at the brand boundary and restrained inside workflows. The supplied Study Worldwide artwork anchors the shell; records, crawl state, provenance, and explicit human review then take visual priority. Decoration never competes with operational truth, and uncertainty remains visible rather than being polished into false confidence.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, high-trust academic character grounded in the supplied brand artwork.
Dense, full-width working surfaces with compact controls and visible evidence.
Flat white panels, fine warm-gray separators, and minimal elevation.
Near-black actions, rare brass detail, and status colors reserved for meaning.
Desktop-first operations with essential statuses, page counts, and actions preserved on mobile.

rules.name: The Rare Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass identifies the brand and guides attention; it never floods working surfaces or substitutes for semantic status color.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Every status color is paired with a text label, and the label remains visible at every supported viewport.

rules.name: The Artwork Owns the Serif Rule
rules.body: Preserve the classical lettering inside the supplied logo; do not manufacture a display-serif substitute in the operational UI.

rules.name: The Numbers Must Scan Rule
rules.body: Totals, dates, durations, and counts use tabular numerals and remain visually compact.

rules.name: The Data Uses the Width Rule
rules.body: Tables and records expand into available workspace width; they are never constrained to a marketing-style narrow column.

rules.name: The Mobile Evidence Rule
rules.body: Responsive reduction may reflow or scroll secondary structure, but crawl status, page counts, and primary actions remain available.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting panels and metric strips use borders and tonal contrast; shadows are reserved for a surface that truly overlays another surface.

rules.name: The Shared Container Rule
rules.body: Related metrics and records share a boundary; do not wrap every item in its own rounded card.

dos: Do make evidence, provenance, review state, and crawl health more prominent than their containers.
Do use the supplied Study Worldwide logo assets at their intended desktop and mobile sizes.
Do keep working surfaces flat, opaque, compact, and separated by warm one-pixel rules.
Do preserve status labels, crawl page counts, keyboard focus, and real actions at narrow widths.
Do use tabular numerals and consistent, unambiguous date formatting for operational data.
Do reserve semantic green, amber, and red for actual system meaning.
donts: Don't use blue or purple accents, gradients, glass effects, glows, or generic AI-sparkle styling.
Don't convert repeatable records or metrics into oversized rounded card galleries.
Don't use antique brass as a default button fill or as small text on white.
Don't hide essential status text, page counts, or critical actions to make mobile layouts look cleaner.
Don't invent data, modules, statuses, or controls to make a screen appear more complete.
Don't imitate the logo's classical serif lettering with decorative type throughout the working UI.
